# OSM edge regression fixtures

The Monaco fixtures are derived from Geofabrik's Monaco extract dated
2022-01-01. They contain nodes and ways with highway or platform tags, and the
directed edges produced by edge-build version 6 with the project configuration.
The synthetic baseline was also produced by version 6.

Monaco data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the
